title: Topic
description: One word-list topic (a single language variant). See docs/PLANNING.md §4.

id.description: Kebab-case topic id; should match the topic folder name.

lang.description: Language code (e.g. "de", "en"). Present only for translated variants; omitted for language-neutral lists.

titles.description: Optional per-language display names for a language-NEUTRAL topic whose word list is identical across locales but whose title translates (e.g. "Athletes"/"Athleten"). Localized variants carry their own `title` instead and don't need this.

lastUpdated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the list's contents last actually changed.

lastChecked.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the list was last verified against its source (even if unchanged). Lets us spot which lists are due for a currency re-check.

oneOf.description: An entry with a short (common) and long (full) name; the UI's per-group Names dropdown picks short / long / both.

group.description: A subtopic; the smallest checkbox unit. Carries exactly one of `words` (flat) or `tiers` (fame-ordered).

tiers.description: Ordered fame tiers, tier 0 = most famous; order within a tier is irrelevant.

preset.description: A named bundle of group ids (e.g. "Include all").

groups.description: References to group ids in this topic; referential integrity is checked by validate-data, not the schema.
